notes.observation: Kalaignar writes 'உயிர் எமக்கு வெல்லமல்ல' while describing colonised peoples who had witnessed mass death. The sentence uses 'வெல்லம்' (jaggery) as a concrete image of sweetness/value rather than only the abstract idea that life is precious.
notes.translation_action: Preserve the jaggery image in the translation rather than flattening it to a purely abstract paraphrase; explain it here in the source notes rather than interrupting Kalaignar's prose.

notes.observation: Near the Cauvery passage the extracted text reads 'நாள் பிறந்த 1924-ல்தான்'. In context, immediately after 'இத்தகு கலவையான சூழ்நிலைகளூடே வழி நடந்த 1924-ல் நான் பிறந்தேன்', the intended reading is evidently 'நான் பிறந்த 1924-ல்தான்'.
notes.translation_action: Translate the contextual reading as 'the 1924 in which I was born' and disclose the intervention here. Do not alter the read-only source repository.

notes.observation: The Cauvery/Hemavathi passage shifts into Kalaignar's contemporary present: the agreement 'is' due for reconsideration in 1974, Tamils 'are' concerned, the Mysore Chief Minister 'has' proceeded, and the Tamil Nadu Government 'has' conveyed its opposition.
notes.translation_action: Retain that contemporary present-time vantage. Do not recast the passage into retrospective past merely because an English reader encounters the memoir later.

notes.observation: Historical and political assertions in this chapter are treated as Kalaignar's authorial claims.
notes.translation_action: Translate faithfully; do not silently fact-correct or replace authorial framing with external historical wording.
